column1: # The Chinese-trace rules' own proof, one case per line: rule, expectation, text.
# "catches" means the rule must match this text, or it would report zero occurrences for content it is
# written to find. "ignores" means it must not, because the text is not a trace: a rule that fires on
# ASCII, on a Latin accent or on the message table's own data is noise, and noise is how a check like
# A case is tried as Go source, and a `// path: <file> ` header names the file it is read as. The rules
# read comments and literals, so they have to be shown a file they read, and the path carries the one
# deliberate exemption: the generated catalog is where this repository's Chinese text is data rather
# A case is one line, so a newline inside it is written `\n`. The text is the last field, so it may
# contain tabs only if they are part of the case.
